newsitem.title: CHINA: China's 7th largest oilfield becomes profitable.
newsitem.headline: China's 7th largest oilfield becomes profitable.

text.p: The Zhongyuan Oilfield, China's seventh largest, has returned to profitability after streamlining its management and bringing its subsidiaries back under tighter control, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

The Zhongyuan field, on the border of eastern Shandong and Henan provinces, will register net profits of 100 million yuan in 1997, compared with a loss of 90 million yuan in 1996, the newspaper said. quoting Liu Jinxin, president of the Zhongyuan Petroleum Exploration Bureau.
The state-run field registered losses for years because its 38 subsidiaries managed their own financial affairs and had moved away from the core business of oil production, the newspaper said.
Zhongyuan had reduced the powers of its subsidiaries and had forced them to operate on a commercial basis, it said.
